$comment: MyOrbitDrive provisional design tokens (Concept A). Contrast ratios computed by tools/kit.py; AA needs 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text and UI.

teal.role: links, accent text, primary button background (white text 5.57)

mint.role: highlights on navy only; never body text on pearl

danger.role: errors (to be contrast-checked in Phase C)

type.family: Inter (SIL OFL 1.1), self-hosted, with system-ui fallback

motion.reducedMotion: no movement; opacity or instant changes only
